Name: Gender Swap Haley Portraits
Author: ryecci
Description:
HD male Haley portraits. Based the color palette off [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9204]these sprites[/url] so they're not 100% accurate to vanilla Stardew.

Install with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]. 

You can use either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9257]Gender swap bachelorettes to male bachelors dialogue (CP)[/url] to change dialogue.

Portraits made with [url=https://picrew.me/ja/image_maker/523501]立ち絵風男子メーカー by krmr on Picrew[/url], with some slight editing and tweaks by me. Artist gives their permission for use in the description.

Downloads.Description: Install with Portraiture, move the PNG images into a folder made in Portraiture/Portraits.
